title: Why Did God Rest?

post.caption: If God never gets tired, why did he rest on day seven? #bible #god #faith #sabbath #christian
post.threads: If God never gets tired, why did he rest on day seven? #bible #faith #sabbath
post.description: If God never gets tired, why did he rest on day seven? Because he was done.

lines.say: [curious] If God never gets tired, why did he rest on day seven? People ask this a lot.
[matter-of-fact] Short answer? He didn't rest because he was tired. He rested because he was done.
[light laugh] Not done like you after a long shift on the couch. Done like a painter who steps back from a finished painting.
[warm] The Bible says: "On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested."

slots.verse: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested

lines.say: Think about it. A song ends. A house is built. A meal is served. Nobody calls that weakness. Finishing is not the same as running out.
[leaning in] Here's the twist: the Hebrew word for rested means to stop. Not to recover. God stopped because nothing was missing.
[softer] Then Jesus said, "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath."

slots.verse: The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

lines.say: So the seventh day was never about God being weak. Not a nap. Not a break. It was a gift, made for you.
[quiet, confident] God rested so you would know you're allowed to stop too. The work is finished. God did it.
